# Threesmith

> MCP server, CLI and Claude Code plugin that makes coding agents better at three.js: the exact API of the installed three version, a scored review pinned to it, asset and decoder checks, the page run headless with the live scene read back, behaviour proven with steps and claims, draw-call and leak measurements, build checks, and 3D models built without Blender.

- Install: `claude mcp add threesmith -- npx -y threesmith mcp` (Node 22.12+; three must be installed in the project). Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add laaielichter/Threesmith`, then `/plugin install threesmith@threesmith`.
- Start: three_doctor (what is wrong, in which order), three_scan (project map)
- Code: three_api, three_search, three_review (101 rules, score 0-100, code+file for unsaved code, only_new for fix loops), three_types (tsc with three.js answers), three_fix (pure renames, undoable), three_impact (what a change touches, which pages and scenarios run it, the checks that prove it), three_migrate (upgrade plan r120 to r188 per release: changes in this code with file:line, TO DO list, what will look different), three_explain, three_lessons, three_lesson_add, three_rules, three_feedback, three_dream (proposals from past sessions on this machine, applied only when approved), three_undo, three_version
- Run: three_check (headless Chromium, errors with causes, blank frames, screenshot, baselines), three_inspect (why objects are not visible), three_play (steps, watch, claims), three_scenario (regression tests), three_perf (draw calls, triangles, budgets), three_device (phone, tablet and low-end profiles: pixel ratio, CPU slow-down, clamped texture limits), three_leaks (what grows per cycle), three_compare (the page on two three releases: console, scene, renderer.info and luminance per object, each change with the migration note that explains it; bisect finds the first release that changes or breaks the page)
- Live: three_session, three_page (a page kept open between calls: eval against the live scene, steps, screenshots)
- Build: three_assets (paths, case, decoders), three_decoders (Draco/KTX2/meshopt wired with the installed three's decoder files, hash-checked, write copies and sets up), three_gltf (validate with glTF-Validator, optimize with gltf-transform; optional packages), three_build (bundle check and the built page headless)
- Models: three_model_brief, three_model_identify, three_model_spec, three_model_build, three_model_view, three_model_lint, three_model_inspect
- Options: --tier cheap|premium, --tools core,run,live,build,model, --read-only
- CLI: threesmith doctor | scan | api | search | review | types | fix | impact | migrate | rules | dream | undo | lessons | assets | decoders | gltf | check | inspect | play | scenario | perf | device | leaks | compare | build | model | explain | ci | mcp
- GitHub Action: laaielichter/Threesmith (receipt on pull requests: review, headless check, scenarios)
- Privacy: nothing leaves the machine, no telemetry
- Source: https://github.com/laaielichter/Threesmith
- Agent install guide: https://github.com/laaielichter/Threesmith/blob/main/llms-install.md
